context: A mom and son chat about a trip
purpose: Teach: 魅了/足らず/斜面/淡路/崖/持ち上げ/高温/ひき

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お絵本の魚、ぼく、本当に、魅了されちゃった、綺麗だね!
lines.en: Mom, the fish in the picture book — I'm really mesmerized. It's so pretty!
lines.style: Breathless rush of genuine wonder. Quick bright attack on the opening. Small-child voice lifting with excitement. Eager to share the discovery, like he's inviting her into something he's seeing for the first time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お小遣い、足らずに、ぼく、おもちゃ、買えなかったって、ママ、気づいたわよ。
lines.en: I know, sweetheart. Your allowance ran short, didn't it? I noticed you didn't get that toy you wanted.
lines.style: Warm and gentle, speaking to the unspoken thing. Soft attack. Understanding tone — she's not correcting him, she's letting him know she sees him. Patient, maternal rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の斜面、ぼく、自転車で、走るの、楽しいよ、ママ、見て!
lines.en: Mom, the slope at the park — riding my bike down it is so fun! Watch me!
lines.style: High-energy burst of pride and eagerness. Quick, wanting to demonstrate, to be watched. Pulsing with the need for approval. Opening word bright and demanding gently, like a hand reaching up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、淡路島の海、家族で、行こうって、お父さん、言ってたよ。
lines.en: Your dad mentioned we should take a family trip to Awaji Island this summer. The beach there.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial sharing. Soft opening, like she's letting him in on a small family secret. Even pace, encouraging but not overselling. A promise nestled inside an ordinary sentence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵本に出てくる崖、すごく高くて、怖かったよ、ぼく、ドキドキした。
lines.en: That cliff in the picture book — it was so high. It scared me. My heart was really pounding.
lines.style: Quieter now, processing something that unsettled him. Slower pace. Small voice reaching for reassurance, not quite finding it. The fear is real, not performed. Pause before the last phrase, like he's checking if it's okay to admit.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんが、重たい荷物、持ち上げて、引っ越し、手伝ってくれたわね、先週。
lines.en: Your dad lifted all those heavy boxes when we moved last week. He really helped us out.
lines.style: Appreciative, reflecting on small acts of care. Warm, steady tone. Not exaggerating, but noticing the gesture. Matter-of-fact admiration — this is the kind of thing worth remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 高温の日、外、走らない方がいいって、ママ、いつも言うね、暑いから。
lines.en: On hot days, you shouldn't run around outside, you know. The heat can really get to you.
lines.style: Gentle, repetitive concern — she says this and he hears it. Not scolding, protecting. Soft opening. The tone of someone who worries in small, practical ways. A familiar rhythm between them.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今夜のハンバーグ、ひき肉、ママが、こねたわよ、楽しみにしてね、翔くん。
lines.en: I kneaded the ground meat for the hamburgers tonight myself, Sho. You can really look forward to it.
lines.style: Tender, close, almost conspiratorial. Soft attack. Speaking directly to him like he's the only one who needs to know. Pride in small effort. The warmth of a mother making something with her hands for someone she loves.
